title: Rainy Day Serenade
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On rainy days, high-school girl Hina dreams of playing as a child with a boy in a garden she has never seen. When she finds the garden, a young man named Takaaki mistakes her for his fiancée Hinako and takes her home, and Hina realizes she has slipped back to Meiji-era Tokyo in 1907, where her double lives. The josei series, from Kodansha's Kiss magazine, ran 14 volumes and is set for a 2027 anime.
life_message: Love and identity are tested by duty, family expectation and time itself, and a person must find her own place among them.
